id: COUNTRY CLUB: With something uncommon in common

metadata.title: COUNTRY CLUB: With something uncommon in common
metadata.author: Mark McClain

entries.clue: Nation with the longest shoreline on the Caspian Sea
Nation whose capital is 92 feet below sea level
Nation where early human fossils were found by Mary Leakey
Nation that's farther from an ocean than any other
Nation with the highest percentage land area on its continent
Nation that pioneered the walking safari
First nation to give women the right to vote (1893)
Nation with the most official languages (16)
Landlocked nation surrounded by landlocked nations
Only nation spelled with two 10-point Scrabble letters
